qualification.promotion_gate: full ds4-eval 92x only if COMPSEC17 is competitive

procedure: Merge this profile and helper script through PR.
Pull main on each target Spark checkout.
Run v2/scripts/ds4_diffusiongemma_gguf_eval.py prepare-llama from the pulled checkout on each target node.
Use v2/scripts/ds4_diffusiongemma_gguf_eval.py download or a repo-owned transfer step to place only the assigned GGUF on each node.
Run write-requests once per prompt mode from the pulled checkout.
Run run-gguf from the pulled checkout on each target node.
Run grade from the pulled checkout and archive collect.json, grade.json, command line, commit hash, node, and model path.
